# Cncf Hyscale Reviewer

Review HyScale using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Continuous Integration &amp; Delivery category. An app-centric abstraction framework over K8s and an enterprise platform for accelerating deployments to multi-cloud Kubernetes. Offers self-service app deployments, container sprawl management across clusters, and DevSecOps.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
